value.rationale: A natural four-real-dimensional Fourier subspace has a previously unresolved sharp two-sided L6/L2 geometry, with a complete arithmetic classification across arbitrary frequency pairs. Sixth moments detect exactly a new quintuple resonance invisible at fourth order and permit strict lower cancellations at 3 and 5 despite ordinary single-tone lower value 5/2. Precise algebraic optimizers and phase rigidity provide a complete useful structural invariant, with known upper content acknowledged.
